gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Distinctive and a bit stubborn, Gugi draws every glyph with one tip. Big and brief is where it earns its keep, while Noto Sans Sunuwar, a sans-serif with short ascender stems, handles the rest.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Bold lettering with a rounded-wire stroke leads here. What stands out most is how Gugi's tight, wire-like line sits sharply against the generous curve gaps of Noto Sans Tagalog.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads approachable, its strokes tapering short of touching. Gugi's single-depth cut stays up top, so paragraphs underneath should move along easily, with that small step from capital to lowercase keeping the texture smooth.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Tall, chunky, unfussy: Gugi holds one stroke thickness throughout while Noto Sans Tai Viet keeps its ascenders short. The standout is Gugi's unvarying line set against that tall x-height below it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplemen: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement reads stocky and contemporary, built from round open-parenthesis forms. Gugi's bowls keep their walls uniform, so text beneath it should feel dense and steady rather than fussy.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa opens its round letters wide and keeps short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. And Gugi's constant stroke from top to baseline means the text below should glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tc: Approachable and open, Noto Sans TC lets its curves swing outward instead of curling in. And Gugi, drawn with a single plotter-pen line, is the one that grabs attention.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Gugi's tall lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, with terminals cut open so counters flow outward. Noto Sans Telugu sits below with a high-set midline, so text should read smoothly and without pinching.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Gugi's tube-like, constant-width stroke gives the heading a chunky and distinctive look right away. And Noto Sans Thai Looped, with its tall bodies and spacious terminal gaps, matches that sturdiness while staying open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Round, steady, marker-like: Gugi keeps its line weight constant across the heading. And Noto Sans Tifinagh, a sans-serif with inflated, rounded bowls, should make paragraphs feel soft and inviting.
